name: agent_municipal_precheck
_description: Fase E.1 - Pre-check normativa municipal. Cruza el proyecto contra municipal_pgou_rules del municipio. Match deterministico (SQL filtrando por municipio + categoria + applies_to) + LLM categoriza aplicabilidad real segun project_context y resume al arquitecto. Output: lista de reglas aplicables, license recomendada, blockers, pitfalls, summary. Persiste en municipal_prechecks. Pre-fase: NO sustituye agent_regulatory, da una vision rapida ANTES de la inversion completa.

parameters.query: SELECT id, name, project_type, location_province, location_city, property_type, property_area_m2, budget_target, urgency, current_phase, metadata FROM projects WHERE id = $1::uuid LIMIT 1
SELECT summary, client_needs, constraints FROM briefings WHERE project_id = $1::uuid ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ warning: $json._warn || null, error: $json._error || null, message: $json._details, municipio_solicitado: $json.municipio_solicitado || null, top5_disponibles: $json.top5_disponibles || null }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT rule_key, rule_category, rule_title, rule_description, normative_reference, normative_url, applies_to, triggers, license_implication, pitfalls, severity FROM municipal_pgou_rules WHERE municipio_slug = $1::text ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critico' THEN 1 WHEN 'importante' THEN 2 WHEN 'recomendable' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, rule_category
INSERT INTO agent_executions (project_id, agent_name, status, started_at, input, metadata) VALUES ($1::uuid, 'agent_municipal_precheck', 'running', now(), $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.project_id, JSON.stringify({ municipio_slug: $json.municipio_slug, rules_prefiltered: $json.rules_prefiltered }), JSON.stringify({ request_id: $json.request_id, source: 'api_municipal_precheck' })] }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO municipal_prechecks (project_id, tenant_id, municipio_slug, rules_matched_count, applicable_rules, recommended_license, blockers, pitfalls_aggregated, summary_for_architect, llm_model, llm_tokens_in, llm_tokens_out, request_id) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::text, $4::int, $5::jsonb, $6::text, $7::jsonb, $8::jsonb, $9::text, $10::text, $11::int, $12::int, $13::text) RETURNING id, created_at
UPDATE agent_executions SET status = 'completed', finished_at = now(), output = $2::jsonb, metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || $3::jsonb WHERE id = $1::uuid

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Start Execution').first().json.id, JSON.stringify({ precheck_id: $('Save Precheck').first().json.id, rules_applicable_count: $('Format Output').first().json.output.rules_applicable_count, recommended_license: $('Format Output').first().json.output.recommended_license, blockers_count: ($('Format Output').first().json.output.blockers || []).length }), JSON.stringify({ model: $('Format Output').first().json.model, tokens_in: $('Format Output').first().json.tokens_in, tokens_out: $('Format Output').first().json.tokens_out, eu_ai_act: 'pre-check informativo, no sustituye agent_regulatory ni decision humana' })] }}
